title: The Conversation
hook: She found the bus. She's been fine.
scene: The Ledger is still parked. Window to window. Fog on the cage. Glasses on the cord. Clipboard on the thigh. He does not ask you a question. She found the bus. She's been fine. Kent lot. I read the collar. I kept her. I was measuring whether you stay quiet. Whether you check. Whether I can trust you with something that cannot protect itself. Same test as a load. Same as the pass. Same as the license. One standard. First time I am saying that out loud. She goes back because I decided. You did not ask. You did not score this. I carried someone else's cat. Waited to see if you'd mention it. You never did. I know why. Take her. You take her. You do not say the name.
debrief: He gives her back because he decided. You take her. You do not say the name.

source.teaching_target: Handover: Deac states the one standard out loud (quiet, checks, trust with what cannot protect itself) and returns Mya because he decided — no quiz, no scored answer.

image_brief.subject: Deac in the high seat, glasses on a cord, amber vest taped at the shoulder, clipboard on the thigh, Mya held against his chest in both hands at the open window
image_brief.foreground: dented thermos and the window ledge, fog on the cage
image_brief.midground: his face, no smile, reddened eyes, the brown mackerel against the vest
image_brief.background: the Ledger's cargo box and long-arm mirrors; fog, downtown dusk; Ali not in frame
image_brief.read: Mya is in his hands at the open window; the clipboard is on his thigh
